faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ratnagiri District Court recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Contractual Employee for e-Seva Kendra Port Cabins post is 15-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate from any branch and possess computer knowledge certificate to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all applicants.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application scrutiny, shortlisting, and an interview. A practical test may also be conducted if required.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Contractual Employee post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 15000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Contractual Employee post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Contractual Employee for e-Seva Kendra Port Cabins post.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the e-Seva Kendra Port Cabin located?
faq.answer: The e-Seva Kendra Port Cabin is located at the Civil Court Rajapur.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any domicile restrictions. However, candidates should check the official notification for any such details.
